snippet.title: Forge & Fleet Official Beta Launch Trailer | Android & iOS
snippet.description:
⚓ Forge & Fleet launches on 14th August 2026 for Android. iOS coming soon!

Forge & Fleet is a free-to-play idle naval RPG where every upgrade shapes your journey across the seas.

⚒️ Forge powerful equipment
🚢 Build and upgrade your ship
👥 Recruit a specialised crew
⚔️ Battle across increasingly dangerous seas
⚓ Join fleets and compete alongside other captains

Forge your fleet. Roll your gear. Outscale everyone.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY:

Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/frogspawn

Website:
https://frogspawnstudio.com/

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/frogspawnstudio?igsh=bnlnbTlpbjJwc212

Developed by Frog Spawn Studio.
